To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the new subsurface redox structure concept can provide a basis for targeted N regulation of agricultural production in Denmark and in other areas with complicated redox structures.

(i) The new subsurface redox structure assessment concept is a cost-efficient method for targeted N regulation of intensive agriculture with low impact to the environment; (ii) The new subsurfaced redox structure assessment can be used in large parts of the developed world where the subsurface is complex; (iii) The new subsurfaceredox structure assessment concept can be used to support sustainable economic development in the developing world.
